title: Democrats Clinch 258 House Seats, an Election-Year Record This Century
partialText: After sweeping midterm wins, Democrats have secured the largest House majority in a national election for either party in three decades.

title: Democrat Chuck Hubbard Defeats 11-Term Republican Virginia Foxx in North Carolina
partialText: Chuck Hubbard, a retired journalist, defeated Representative Virginia Foxx in a conservative district.

title: Republicans Debate Why They Lost the Midterms, and if Trump Is to Blame
partialText: A divide is emerging in the party over what caused its wipeout midterm defeats, foreshadowing a battle over how to move forward before 2028.

title: Is Annie Andrews Too Real for the Senate? South Carolinians Are About to Find Out.
partialText: The pediatrician, who once compared JD Vance to the herpes virus, notched one of the most shocking upsets of the midterm elections by defeating Senator Darline Graham.

title: COP31 Talks Collapse in Turkey in a Clash Over Fossil Fuels
partialText: European and vulnerable nations rejected a proposed agreement after Saudi Arabia and other oil producers blocked any mention of phasing out coal, oil and gas.

title: How Melania Trump Found a Diplomatic Opening in the War in Ukraine
partialText: The first lady, who has little experience in international affairs, developed back channels to key figures on both sides of the conflict through her longtime agent.

title: Fact-Checking Stephen Miller, the New White House Chief of Staff
partialText: Mr. Miller has promoted some of the second Trump administration’s most egregious falsehoods about immigration policy, the economy and political opposition.

title: Looking for the Formula to Stop an Apocalypse
partialText: Mike Winer and his colleagues are trying to build a mathematical safeguard to keep A.I. under human control. They fear they are running out of time.

title: Easy Thanksgiving Recipes That Take Up Absolutely No Oven Space
partialText: Dishes for the stovetop, the slow-cooker, the air fryer, the Instant Pot and more.

title: Andrew Scott on the Shattering Feat of Playing Ian Charleson in ‘Elsinore’
partialText: Scott is the subject of Oscar chatter for his performance recreating the last months of Ian Charleson for the biopic “Elsinore.”

title: What Does It Actually Mean to Write ‘Like a Human’?
partialText: The hunt for A.I. writing has turned many of us into detectives. A Kenyan writer asks what we’re really looking for.

title: Why Are We at the Mercy of the World’s Weirdest Men?
partialText: No kings isn’t just about Trump.

title: Delta Delays Flights as Thanksgiving Travel Begins, After Automated System Falters
partialText: The system that faltered is used to calculate the weight and balance of departing flights. The disruptions came after a nationwide ground stop that canceled thousands of flights last weekend.
